activity.notes: Hugo Chávez served as President of Venezuela from 2 February 1999 until his death on 5 March 2013. The country adopted the constitutional name Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela during his first year in office; ATLAS uses the stable polity label Venezuela rather than splitting one presidency solely for the state's formal-name change. Chávez was briefly removed from effective control during the April 2002 coup attempt but was restored within days, and standard presidential chronologies treat his mandate as continuous from 1999 to 2013.
